title: refactor(mdx-loader): make loader setup synchronous (AI-assisted)
body:
## Breaking Changes

- `MDXPlugin` now uses Unified's `Pluggable` type. Plugin functions, option tuples, and presets remain supported; invalid entries previously accepted by `any` now fail type checking.
- `createMDXLoaderItem`, `createMDXLoaderRule`, and the pages plugin factory now return their results synchronously. Existing `await` calls still work; replace direct `.then(...)` calls with synchronous use. MDX document processing remains asynchronous.

## Pre-flight checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines on pull requests](https://github.com/facebook/docusaurus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests).
- [x] **If this is a code change**: I have written unit tests and/or added dogfooding pages to fully verify the new behavior.
- [ ] **If this is a new API or substantial change**: the PR has an accompanying issue (closes #0000) and the maintainers have approved on my working plan.

## Motivation

Concurrent compilation with the same uncached options could initialize separate MDX processors. Flatten processor construction and populate the cache synchronously so concurrent files reuse one processor while async plugins continue to work.

Make the loader APIs and content-plugin rule builders synchronous, remove obsolete ESM type workarounds, and replace duplicated `any` aliases with Unified's `Pluggable`. Upgrade `stringify-object` to 7.0.0 and use its bundled types.

(AI-assisted)

## Test Plan

- Added concurrent-compilation regression tests for Markdown and MDX; both failed before the cache fix and pass afterward, including async plugin execution and per-document data.
- `pnpm test`: 184 files, 2,978 tests passed.
- `pnpm build:packages` and `pnpm build:website:fast`: passed.
- Website typechecking with TypeScript 6 and 7, MDX loader typechecking with TypeScript 6, and ESLint/formatting checks passed (no lint errors).
- Argos visual checks requested.

### Test links

Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-12461--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/

- [MDX pages](https://deploy-preview-12461--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/tests/pages/markdown-tests-mdx)
- [Markdown pages](https://deploy-preview-12461--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/tests/pages/markdown-tests-md)
- [Admonitions](https://deploy-preview-12461--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/tests/docs/tests/admonitions)
- [Images](https://deploy-preview-12461--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/tests/docs/tests/images)
- [Blog](https://deploy-preview-12461--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/tests/blog)

## Related issues/PRs

Follow-up to #12458.
